issues.headline: 107 WINS: DAY-TRIPPERS CLOSE THE BOOK ON THE REGULAR SEASON
issues.dek: Dock Ellis Day-Trippers finished the regular season 107-55, first of 30 clubs by winning percentage and 14 games clear of Madison Mashers. The postseason is next.
lead: One hundred sixty-two games are in the books. Over 162 games, Dock Ellis Day-Trippers went 107-55 (.660). They scored 833 runs and allowed 654, 5.14 a game against 4.04; the staff's ERA was 3.71.
Edgar Martinez led the club at the plate: .318/.401/.629, OPS+ 168, 6 home runs over 152 plate appearances. David Ortiz (OPS+ 141, 13 HR) was next.
The rotation's anchor was Madison Bumgarner: 23-5, 2.51 ERA (ERA+ 187) in 236.1 innings over 33 starts.
Willie Hernandez closed the door 15 times (ERA 2.89, ERA+ 162).
"We'll celebrate in a few weeks," said bench coach Lefty Mahoney. "Maybe."

paras: Ernie Banks finished at .218/.292/.372 (OPS+ 75) over 319 plate appearances. The postseason is a fresh line for everybody.

sidebars.title: Rival Watch

The rotation ran through Dave Stieb: 5 starts, a 1.21 ERA over 37.1 innings (ERA+ 449), 10.1 strikeouts per nine.
"Write down that I called it," said bench coach Lefty Mahoney. Nobody wrote it down.

issues.headline: 81 WINS AND COUNTING FOR DAY-TRIPPERS
issues.dek: Dock Ellis Day-Trippers sit 81-45, first of 30 clubs by winning percentage, 4.5 games clear of Madison Mohicans with 35 games left.
lead: The calendar has started doing the talking. Through 126 games of a 162-game season, Dock Ellis Day-Trippers are 81-45 (.643). They have scored 635 runs and allowed 521, 5.04 a game against 4.13; the staff's ERA is 3.77.
David Ortiz leads the club at the plate: .313/.417/.556, OPS+ 154, 12 home runs over 290 plate appearances. Albert Pujols (OPS+ 122, 23 HR) is next.
The rotation's anchor has been Madison Bumgarner: 19-4, 2.58 ERA (ERA+ 184) in 188.2 innings over 26 starts.
Willie Hernandez has closed the door 12 times (ERA 2.64, ERA+ 179).
"Lead is a lead," said bench coach Lefty Mahoney. "I'd take a bigger one."
